name: driver_of_the_dead_returns_a_mana_value_two_creature
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature dies, return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.' Driver of the Dead dies. Seat 0's graveyard holds a creature card of mana value 2 and one of mana value 1; seat 0 targets the mana value 2 card, which returns to the battlefield under seat 0's control; the other stays.
